notes.title: Bug fixes and QoL updates
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES

 Added a new screen for stories, where you will now find the introduction
 Added a setting for limiting FPS to prevent screen tearing
 Added an accessibility setting to make lights flash a little less
 Added a warning screen at the start of the game to remind players that this game has flashing lights and loud noises
 Added a "failed to connect" screen when connecting to a lobby that isn't valid
 Added a way to skip dialogue in the introduction if you've previously completed the step, allowing you to get back to where you were if the game crashes or your power goes out
 Did some UI changes, which should make the game more accessible for more screen resolutions, including ultrawide
 Ghost orbs will no longer spawn until the ghost spends the previous energy
 Ghosts can now only kill one player per hunt


BUG FIXES

 The bug that caused all UI to disappear when connecting to certain lobbies, forcing you to exit the game has been fixed
 Fixed some light and occlusion bugs in the main map
 Fixed lights in the introduction acting strangely, which made items seem as they disappeared
 Moved the light switch in the bathroom so it doesn't float
 Made floors thicker to prevent light from passing through
 Ghost energy overlay now works properly (it didn't go away when spending energy)

notes.title: Medium update
notes.notes:
This update fixes some major bugs, as well as introduces some graphical changes.

PATCH NOTES

 Remade the smoke effect in sage
 Revamped some of the wallpaper to make them look more realistic
 Made the lobby window wider to allow for longer lobby names
 Added text in the lobby to indicate when there are no public lobbies available to join
 Added a light effect to matches
 Added an indicator to show which nearby object is radioactive when being near it with a geiger counter
 Added a loading screen when entering the introduction, as well as when unloading the house map


BUG FIXES

 Rainbow orb should no longer exist
 Equipment (EMF and Geiger counter) should now work properly
 Failing exorcisms should now properly disable all items involved
 Fixed doors being "locked" randomly
 Lobbies with 0 players should no longer be visible
 Your screen should no longer be obscured while cleansing the house
 Fixed leaks in walls
 The ghost should no longer chase dead players

notes.title: An update for the weekend
notes.notes:
I've been working hard on this new update, and finally see it as ready to be played by the playtesters. There has been some issues, but hopefully most of them have been fixed. Looking forward, I'll be mostly focused on fixing bugs, optimization, and smaller tweaks to make the game look better. I have a lot of work to do regarding cleaning up the code, so I hope this update brings enough joy for a while.

I really have to thank the people who have helped me test the game. Their feedback has been so valuable, and I've used a lot of their input to tweak the game. I hope more people will be interested in testing the game and give me feedback the days ahead of us. 

So a little about this update then; I've added a basement to the game. This adds a huge amount of extra space, so the rounds will hopefully last a lot longer. There is a hidden object in the basement, which can be used to counter the ghost. A bunch of tweaks with hitboxes - it's now much harder for objects to clip through furniture. Graphics adjustments. I've also been working a lot on SFX changes. 

There is also a language setting for Italian, although it's still in beta.

Enjoy!
